TOP RIGHT — slam (v.砰地关上): A person forcefully closes a wooden door, short curved motion arc and bold sound marks at the door frame; no injured hand.

review_notes: Viewed all four cells: flee shows an adult exiting smoke and glancing back; slam has forceful door motion marks; gangster is a generic thief beside a warehouse; Chicago shows recognizable skyline and elevated rail above water.
